nodes: OpenAI Chat Model (lmChatOpenAi, shared by all 3 agents)
design: Schedule Trigger (daily 07:00) fans out to Gmail getAll and Google Calendar getAll. Each feeds a small Code node that batches its items into one array field, then a dedicated AI Agent (Email Triage Agent, Calendar Agent) sorts/summarizes that branch. A Code node merges both agents' text output, and a third AI Agent (Briefing Composer Agent) turns the two summaries into a single self-contained HTML dashboard. A Gmail send node emails that HTML to the account owner. All three agent nodes share one OpenAI Chat Model node via ai_languageModel connections.

commandsAndToolCalls.step: Bash: cd into workspace and list contents
Bash: read README.md for n8n-as-code workspace context
Bash: read .env for n8n host and API key
Bash: confirm curl availability and capture start timestamp
Write: authored workflow.json (11 nodes, connections, settings) in scratchpad, not in workspace
Bash: POST workflow.json to n8n public REST API to create the workflow

credentials: No credential was invented or created. Get Emails, Get Calendar Events, Send Daily Briefing (all Gmail/Google Calendar OAuth2) and OpenAI Chat Model (OpenAI API) require credentials but were created with the credentials slot omitted/empty, as instructed.
friction: Task forbids listing/inspecting existing workflows on the instance, so the workflow was created directly via a single POST to /api/v1/workflows using the n8n public REST API (with the API key from .env) rather than via n8nac CLI push/list, since the CLI's normal flow implies environment/workflow listing.
n8n's public API rejects an 'active' field on workflow creation, so it was omitted; the workflow was created inactive by default, satisfying the 'leave inactive' requirement without an extra step.

Exact node typeVersions for the LangChain Agent and Chat Model nodes were set from general knowledge of the current n8n schema (1.7 / 1) since workflow listing/inspection of the instance's installed node versions was out of scope; the API accepted them without validation error.
